_: It.22: an NPC that ESCORTS THE PLAYER to a destination via the Escort procedure template (Skyrim.esm:0x023B73) — the DUAL of It.21's Follow. Slot 11 'Target to Escort' = the player (0x000014, defaulted when omitted, exactly like Follow's slot 0). Slot 3 'Destination' is a PackageDataLocation pointing at the in-spec marker MF_EscortDest — this exercises the build's new DEFERRED-LOCATION wiring (a location slot that points at a placement created later in the placement loop, resolved after placements register, the same way patrol-start/follow-target SingleRefs are deferred). The NPC walks AHEAD toward the marker and pauses if the player lags past `waitDistance`; the player tags along behind. Both NPC and destination marker sit on the It.16b-confirmed walkable corridor of the Sleeping Giant Inn (cell 0x0133C6): the NPC at cell-local (0,0,0), the marker at the vanilla RiverwoodInnCenterMarker spot (-977.29, 9.08, 0) which It.16b proved a generated NPC can path to. Citizenship recipe (crimeFaction + town faction + unique) included so cross-door escort would work too. `coc RiverwoodSleepingGiantInn`, wait ~30-90s cold-start, then walk toward him — he should set off for the far marker, glancing back / waiting when you fall behind.

packages._: Escort template. target omitted ⇒ escorts the player (Skyrim.esm:0x000014). destination = the MF_EscortDest marker placement (resolved via the deferred-location path). waitDistance = how far the player may lag before the NPC pauses; lowered from the 512 default so he waits more visibly in the cramped inn. accompany-style leading: he walks ahead, you follow.

placements._: The guide, spawned at the It.16b-confirmed NPC spawn (0,0,0) in the Sleeping Giant Inn.

Escort destination marker at the vanilla RiverwoodInnCenterMarker position (-977.29, 9.08, 0) — It.16b confirmed a generated NPC can walk here, so it is on reachable navmesh. An XMarkerHeading; auto-persistent because the package's deferred Destination location links to it.
